title: Array.from builds arrays from anything
why_it_matters: Handy for page numbers, placeholder items and Sets.
explanation: Array.from creates an array from anything list-like or iterable, such as a string or a Set. Give it an object with just a length, plus a mapping function, and you can generate sequences like page numbers or dummy items for testing.
code:
console.log(Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => i + 1)); // [1, 2, 3]
console.log(Array.from("abc"));                          // ["a", "b", "c"]
console.log(Array.from(new Set([1, 1, 2])));             // [1, 2]
try_it: Generate [10, 20, 30, 40] with Array.from and a mapping function.
